examples.name: Default
examples.summary: Default dropdown with a single unlabeled group of six options and no left/right affordances. Click the trigger to open; controls drive placement, offset, and disabled.
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import DropdownMenu, {
    DropdownMenuGroup,
    DropdownMenuOption,
    DropdownMenuTrigger
  } from '@aziontech/webkit/dropdown-menu'
  import IconButton from '@aziontech/webkit/icon-button'
</script>

<template>
  <DropdownMenu>
    <DropdownMenuTrigger>
      <IconButton
        kind="outlined"
        icon="pi pi-plus"
        aria-label="Open menu"
      />
    </DropdownMenuTrigger>
    <DropdownMenuGroup>
      <DropdownMenuOption
        value="profile"
        label="Profile"
      />
      <DropdownMenuOption
        value="settings"
        label="Settings"
      />
      <DropdownMenuOption
        value="billing"
        label="Billing"
      />
      <DropdownMenuOption
        value="invite"
        label="Invite members"
      />
      <DropdownMenuOption
        value="logs"
        label="Audit log"
      />
      <DropdownMenuOption
        value="signout"
        label="Sign out"
      />
    </DropdownMenuGroup>
  </DropdownMenu>
</template>

examples.name: Groups
examples.summary: Two labeled groups (`Account`, `Workspace`) separated by an automatic top divider on the second group. One option carries a `command` hint, another is `selected` — the central anatomy of this component.
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import DropdownMenu, {
    DropdownMenuGroup,
    DropdownMenuOption,
    DropdownMenuTrigger
  } from '@aziontech/webkit/dropdown-menu'
  import IconButton from '@aziontech/webkit/icon-button'
</script>

<template>
  <DropdownMenu>
    <DropdownMenuTrigger>
      <IconButton
        kind="outlined"
        icon="pi pi-plus"
        aria-label="Open menu"
      />
    </DropdownMenuTrigger>
    <DropdownMenuGroup label="Account">
      <DropdownMenuOption
        value="profile"
        label="Profile"
        command="⌘P"
      />
      <DropdownMenuOption
        value="settings"
        label="Settings"
      />
    </DropdownMenuGroup>
    <DropdownMenuGroup label="Workspace">
      <DropdownMenuOption
        value="invite"
        label="Invite members"
      />
      <DropdownMenuOption
        value="logs"
        label="Audit log"
        selected
      />
    </DropdownMenuGroup>
  </DropdownMenu>
</template>

examples.name: States
examples.summary: Panel forced open (`open="true"`) showing each spec-declared option state side-by-side: `default`, `selected`, and `disabled`. The `hover` and `focus-visible` states are interactive — focus an option with the keyboard (`Down` / `Up`) or hover with the pointer to see them.
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import DropdownMenu, {
    DropdownMenuGroup,
    DropdownMenuOption,
    DropdownMenuTrigger
  } from '@aziontech/webkit/dropdown-menu'
  import IconButton from '@aziontech/webkit/icon-button'
</script>

<template>
  <DropdownMenu :open="true">
    <DropdownMenuTrigger>
      <IconButton
        kind="outlined"
        icon="pi pi-plus"
        aria-label="Open menu"
      />
    </DropdownMenuTrigger>
    <DropdownMenuGroup label="Option states">
      <DropdownMenuOption
        value="default"
        label="Default"
      />
      <DropdownMenuOption
        value="selected"
        label="Selected"
        selected
      />
      <DropdownMenuOption
        value="disabled"
        label="Disabled"
        disabled
      />
    </DropdownMenuGroup>
  </DropdownMenu>
</template>
